extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question on average body mass by sex: (1) 'Adeile' in the species column was a misspelling of 'Adelie' and was corrected; (2) whitespace variants in 'island' (e.g., ' Dream', ' Torgersen') were normalized; (3) uppercase variants in 'sex' (e.g., 'FEMALE', 'MALE') were normalized to lowercase; (4) one row with a negative flipper length (-176 mm) was excluded as it was below the valid range (170–235 mm); (5) three rows with extremely high body mass values (3.2M–3.7M g) were excluded as they exceeded the valid range (2500–6500 g); (6) two exact duplicate rows were removed. After these fixes, the average body mass for females is 4058.75 g and for males is 4707.35 g.
